UserProfile.title: UserProfile
UserProfile.description: Stores user access control profile, login schedule (start/end dates), admin notes, login counts, and RBAC status.

uid.description: Firebase Auth UID or pre-registered user document ID.

email.description: Verified lowercase email address of the user.

profesi.description: User's profession (e.g. Ahli Gizi / Pengelola SPPG).

namaSPPG.description: Name of the SPPG associated with this user.

peran.description: Role of the user in the multi-tenant system.

mulaiPada.description: Optional start login date (YYYY-MM-DD) controlled by Admin.

berakhirPada.description: Optional expiration date (YYYY-MM-DD) controlled by Admin. Empty string means Tanpa Batas (unlimited).

keterangan.description: Custom admin note displayed to the user on waiting, scheduled, expired, or blocked screens.

loginPertama.description: Timestamp of the user's first detected login.

loginTerakhir.description: Timestamp of the user's most recent login.

loginCount.description: Total number of times the user has signed in.

registeredViaSpreadsheet.description: Whether the user was registered or synchronized via Google Sheets.

emailVerified.description: Whether the user's email address is verified.

lastDeviceId.description: ID of the last device used by this user.

lastDeviceLabel.description: Human-readable label of the user's last active device.

AdminConfig.title: AdminConfig
AdminConfig.description: Stores global admin settings including application logo, Google Spreadsheet link, and Apps Script Webhook URL.

webhookUrl.description: Google Apps Script Web App webhook URL for automatic summary and database push.

autoWebhookEnabled.description: Whether automatic webhook pushes run on login and Admin status updates.

logoUrl.description: Global application logo URL propagated to login screen and tenant dashboards.

DeviceSession.title: DeviceSession
DeviceSession.description: Tracks each connected device automatically in real time for Admin Panel visibility.

deviceType.description: Form factor of the connected device.

ipAddress.description: Network IP address observed by the server.

sessionState.description: Current session state of the device.

userUid.description: Associated user UID if signed in or registering.

userEmail.description: Associated user email if signed in or registering.

peran.description: Role of the user on this device.

statusPersetujuan.description: Approval status of the user on this device.

isOnline.description: Whether the device is currently active.

firstSeenAt.description: First time this device accessed the application.

AppState.title: AppState
AppState.description: Stores a specific slice of the user's isolated application workspace state.

userId.description: The user ID this state belongs to.

stateKey.description: The key identifier of the state slice (e.g., profile, sekolah, tigab, menu, foodCost, tkpi, kopConfig, ikssData, sopData).

updatedAt.description: Timestamp when this state slice was last updated.

/users/{userId}.description: User access control and approval record managed by Admin Panel.

/users/{userId}/states/{stateKey}.description: Isolated per-tenant application workspace state slices.

/users/{userId}/devices/{deviceId}.description: Sub-collection tracking devices linked to a specific user.

/devices/{deviceId}.description: Top-level real-time device registry readable by Admin Panel.

/configs/{configId}.description: Admin global configuration documents (app_logo, user_sheet_sync, admin_settings).

/global_settings/{settingId}.description: Shared reference configuration documents managed by Admin (e.g. tkpi).
